Topic 3.3: The good life of Jesus Christ

SECTION 1: WELCOME

Hello! This is a study lesson on The good life of Jesus Christ. Read the explanation, follow every worked example, then do the practice. This is original CBC Learn content written from KICD outcomes — not a copy of a commercial textbook.

Big question: What did he do?

SECTION 2: WHAT YOU WILL LEARN

By the end of this lesson, you will be able to:

1. Explain the main ideas in The good life of Jesus Christ
2. Give Kenyan examples for The good life of Jesus Christ
3. Practise The good life of Jesus Christ at school and at home

SECTION 3: STUDY NOTES (READ AND LEARN)

WHAT YOU ARE LEARNING: THE GOOD LIFE OF JESUS CHRIST
This lesson teaches The good life of Jesus Christ for Grade 3 CHRISTIAN RELIGIOUS EDUCATION.

STUDY STEPS
1. Explain the main ideas in The good life of Jesus Christ
   Practise this until you can do it without help.

   Practise this until you can do it without help.
3. Practise The good life of Jesus Christ at school and at home
   Practise this until you can do it without help.

HOW TO SHOW UNDERSTANDING
Explain the idea in your own words, give one Kenyan example, then complete the practice tasks.

SECTION 4: QUICK EXAMPLES

Example 1: Describe The good life of Jesus Christ using something at your school.

Example 2: Give a home/community example from your county.

Example 3: Teach a younger child one idea from this lesson in simple words.

SECTION 5: PRACTICE NOW

1. Underline the key ideas about The good life of Jesus Christ above.
2. Explain The good life of Jesus Christ to a parent using one local example.
3. Write or draw three things that prove you understand The good life of Jesus Christ.

SECTION 6: WORK TO DO (HOME / REVISION)

1. Write five sentences about The good life of Jesus Christ with school or home examples.
2. Answer: Why is The good life of Jesus Christ important for a Grade 3 learner?
3. Prepare a one-minute oral presentation for a parent or teacher.
